| Status | `429 Too Many Requests` |
| Type | `https://messagecrate.app/docs/developer/reference/errors/rate-limited` |

The server refused an authentication attempt because too many came too fast: more than 20 attempts inside 60 seconds at one account's password, or to register an account or claim Message Crate, which count once for the whole server, or more than 120 logins as usernames that name no account, also counted once for the whole server. Logging in as an account under any spelling of its username counts against its password, and so does a current password sent to change the owner's password or to delete an account. A login that succeeds, and a right current password, are not counted. Wait the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header (repeated as `retry_after` in the body) and try again.
